# Line Up

> Your path, in sight. A head-up display and cockpit companion for general aviation pilots.

Line Up projects highway-in-the-sky approach paths, visual traffic pattern cues, traffic and terrain alerts, time-stamped weather briefings, and phase-aware checklists. It is portable, works offline from engine start, keeps the instrument panel unobstructed, and clears the display with one button press. Supplemental situational awareness only; certified instruments remain primary on every flight.
